_: The newsroom source register. A source is not eligible for automated intake because it is technically reachable -- it is eligible because it is listed here as APPROVED, with its reuse terms recorded. scripts/lib/newsroom/sources.mjs is the only reader.

states.APPROVED: Cleared for automated intake under the recorded terms.
states.CANDIDATE: Under evaluation. Readable by a human operator; never polled automatically.
states.DISABLED: Must not be contacted by automation at all, for any reason, including a manual retry.

reliabilityClasses.primary-record: Issues the record itself: statutes, decisions, agency releases, official datasets.
reliabilityClasses.wire: Established wire service with a published corrections policy.
reliabilityClasses.outlet: Reported journalism from a named masthead.
reliabilityClasses.aggregator: Republishes others. A lead only -- never citable as the source.

sources.notes: CANDIDATE until reuse terms are confirmed against the publisher's own terms page by a human. Listed to exercise the registry, not to authorise intake.
Safety guidance is a high-risk category in newsroom-policy.json: intake may inform a draft, publication stays human-reviewed.
